requirement.title: Only team administrators may start new discussions
requirement.explanation: Generated test asserting AC-1, AC-2 passed against the running application.
requirement.source: Team Collaboration - Business Requirements Specification §4.2 Discussion governance

notes: Agent rationale: Creates an ADMIN by registering a new team and a USER by joining that team via the Join Existing Team switch and Team combobox. AC-1 asserts the member sees the Discussions page but not the Create Discussion button. AC-2 signs in as the administrator and asserts Create Discussion is available on Discussions. Admin session after login is confirmed via the admin-only Users nav link because login may land on /app without the dashboard role heading.
